name: catalog-products-public-readback
objective: Re-prove central catalog/product field mutations and required public readback without local shadow catalog truth.
truthOwner: Central DSH catalog/product/store truth is authoritative; field may perform only scoped lookup/link/proposal/price-stock mutations and bounded readback.

tasks.objective: Re-prove centralized catalog/product authority and bounded field-to-partner/client readback for one store/product identity.
tasks.currentProblem: Historical U006 PASS does not prove current BB and local/shadow catalog regressions would violate the architecture.
tasks.requiredChange: Execute same-product lookup/link/proposal/price-stock/publication scenarios and remove only reproduced shadow/divergent truth.
tasks.targetState: Field mutations use central catalog/store-product contracts and bounded surfaces read the same canonical product state with correct publication gates.
tasks.action: Trace and run lookup/link/proposal plus store-local price/stock, then compare operator/partner/client readback using stable IDs and negative unpublished/wrong-store cases.
mustNotChange: Do not add a local app-field catalog.
Do not make client public state authoritative.
Do not change unrelated checkout/order flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Partner/operator/client readback is consistent and publication-gated.
tasks.rollback: Revert only a focused reproduced-defect fix; preserve centralized catalog ownership.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused catalog/product commit only if current verification reproduces a defect.
